items.title: IBM CEO says open weight models are now good and cheap on-prem
items.summary: IBM's CEO announced that open weight models have reached a level of affordability and performance that makes them viable for on-premises deployment. This shift could empower more organizations to leverage advanced AI capabilities without relying on cloud services.

items.title: PaperPilot – Zero-Cloud, Pure-Rust PDF Engine with WASM and MCP
items.summary: PaperPilot introduces a PDF engine built entirely in Rust, designed for zero-cloud environments and utilizing WebAssembly for performance. This innovation allows developers to handle PDF generation and manipulation locally, enhancing privacy and reducing dependency on external services.

items.title: Show HN: A Truly Modular Keyboard
items.summary: A new open-source project has emerged that focuses on creating a truly modular keyboard, allowing users to customize every aspect of their typing experience. This initiative not only promotes user personalization but also encourages sustainable practices in hardware design.

items.title: Show HN: TitleArt – Make text like it's 1997
items.summary: TitleArt is a new web tool that allows users to create retro-style text graphics reminiscent of the late 90s. This tool could be particularly appealing for web developers looking to add a nostalgic touch to their projects or personal websites.

items.title: Clear, compelling, accurate headline without clickbait
items.summary: A recent article discusses the evolving landscape of context engineering, emphasizing the importance of understanding user context in software development. This insight is crucial for engineers aiming to build more intuitive and user-centered applications.
